findings.description: Default progressing agent turns have infinite total-step and wall-time budgets; the delegated runSubagent loop also has no total step or time ceiling. Local request idle/first-byte limits do not bound a local stream that continues sending data.
test_evidence: cli/test/compaction_continuity.test.ts:75-95 documents and tests >300 progressing steps without forced termination; not executed in this audit
findings.operational_impact: A model can continue making distinct changes and consume unbounded session time, provider requests and tool resources until external cancellation or a failure occurs.
findings.recommended_action: Add finite operator-configured task budgets enforced by a shared tracker across direct turns, subagents, provider retry and every tool; exhaustion must remain non-success.

findings.description: Explicit maxTotalSteps and maxTurnMinutes are checked against counters initialized for each runTurnImpl invocation. Persisted cumulativeSteps is marked observability-only, so resuming a task receives a fresh per-turn budget; operation runner's 10,000 transition ceiling also applies per invocation.
findings.operational_impact: Repeated operator/service resume can exceed an intended task-wide work or elapsed-time budget while every individual invocation reports ordinary budget exhaustion.
findings.recommended_action: Persist consumed task budgets with durable objective/operation state and pass remaining budget into each resume and child execution; renewal must be explicit and attributable.

findings.description: The active main/v1-integration ruleset requires the three CI checks but zero approving reviews, no code-owner review and non-strict status checks. Candidate changes can modify CI/verifier source without an independently required reviewer, weakening the authority that reports their own checks.
source_locations: GitHub ruleset 25340146 API snapshot 2026-11-18: required_approving_review_count=0, require_code_owner_review=false, strict_required_status_checks_policy=false
test_evidence: Read-only `gh api repos/mikeholownych/nexus-code/rulesets/25340146` query returned active branch ruleset, three required checks, zero required approvals, and no bypass actors
findings.operational_impact: A green check can be made less meaningful by changing the workflow or verifier in the same candidate; incorrect code can be accepted without external review.
findings.recommended_action: Require independent/code-owner approval for workflow, verifier, policy and test-harness paths; require strict checks and protect required workflow implementation from candidate self-modification.

findings.description: FlightRecorder catches append failures and returns an event without recording it; local flight logs have no tamper-evident chain or signature. These logs cannot substantiate a complete execution history.
findings.operational_impact: Forensic records can be missing or rewritten silently. This primarily undermines diagnosis and audit reconstruction, not the structured TurnResult success predicate.
findings.recommended_action: Keep optional telemetry best effort but mark skipped writes; implement a hash-chained export/verify manifest for required acceptance evidence and fail acceptance if its required receipt cannot persist.

findings.description: The examined paths contain per-tool output/time bounds and context admission but no demonstrated product-wide process memory, persistent disk, provider spend or concurrent-session admission limit.
findings.operational_impact: Concurrent or long-lived sessions may exhaust shared host/provider resources and impair unrelated sessions or recovery.
findings.recommended_action: Measure multi-session memory/disk/process behavior and add admission limits through existing ResourceRegistry, client lease and process registry seams.

findings.description: Rust Clippy is installed by the pinned toolchain and passed locally with warnings denied, but CI workflows do not run it; TypeScript has strict type checking but no configured lint/complexity gate.
test_evidence: Local `cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings` exited 0; it is not a CI gate
findings.operational_impact: Static diagnostics may regress between local review and merge without a required CI signal.
findings.recommended_action: Add Clippy to protected CI after baseline confirmation; maintain strict TS build and introduce only targeted complexity diagnostics for critical functions.
